title: Inconsistent MRT Fare-pricing along Downtown Line
what_it_is: Inconsistent MRT Fare-pricing along Downtown Line

sections.label: PTC fare route calculation
sections.summary: The Public Transport Council computes fares using the route with the shortest travel time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: To compute the fare, the Public Transport Council (PTC) uses the route which enables the shortest time of travel.

sections.label: Fares for seniors and disabled
sections.summary: PTC uses the NSEW Lines routing so seniors and disabled pay $0.88 instead of $0.92, applying a lower-fare principle.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Fares from Bukit Panjang to Newton or Bugis for these two vulnerable groups are currently $0.88 based on the NSEW Lines routing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Had PTC used the DTL2 routing, our seniors and disabled would have had to pay a higher fare of $0.92.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: PTC has, therefore, applied an additional fare charging principle: it will use the route for fare calculation only if all commuters will enjoy lower or the same fares.

sections.label: Distance-based fare calculation
sections.summary: Most journeys use distance-based fares, but PTC uses old NSEW Line routing for some station pairs to avoid higher fares.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Actually, 99% of the journeys will be based on the distance approach to calculating fares.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: For example, for an adult commuter travelling between Farrer Park and Newton, their fares have come down from $1.09 to $0.93.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: DTL2 has saved them both time and cost.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: However, for a few station pairs, such as Bukit Panjang-Newton and Bukit Panjang-Bugis, PTC has used the old NSEW Line routing to compute the fares so as to ensure that no commuters need to pay higher fares as a result of DTL2.

sections.label: Fare framework inconsistency
sections.summary: PTC's approach creates some inconsistency and anomaly in the fare framework.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Understandably, this approach by PTC gives rise to some inconsistency, some anomaly, in the fare framework.
